verdict.rationale: Cursor Automations are documented, but they are created through the Agents Window, cursor.com/automations, the /automate skill or Marketplace templates, and no evidence shows version history, change review or rollback for them. Only adjacent automation configuration lives in files that git can version and PRs can review: skills are described as "version-controlled packages", and hooks.json, project rules and project-level CLI permission files sit in the project. missing for 10: versioning of Automations themselves, a review/approval flow for automation changes, rollback to a prior automation version, and hands-on corroboration.
